title: Rust: HashMap and HashSet
description: Use Rust's HashMap, HashSet, and Vec collections for data storage and lookup.

steps.title: Create and Populate HashMap
steps.description: Create a `HashMap<&str, i32>` mapping fruits to their prices: apple=1, banana=2, cherry=3. Print the map using `{:?}`.

verification.failureMessage: Create and print a fruit→price HashMap.

steps.title: HashMap Get and Insert
steps.description: Write a function `get_or_insert(map: &mut HashMap<String, i32>, key: String, value: i32) -> i32` that returns existing value or inserts and returns the default.

steps.title: Word Count with HashMap
steps.description: Count word frequencies in the sentence `"the cat in the hat"` using a HashMap. Print each word and its count.
hints: Iterate with `for (word, count) in &map { println!("{}: {}", word, count); }`

steps.title: HashSet for Unique Values
steps.description: Given `[1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 4, 5, 4]`, use a `HashSet` to find unique numbers. Print them sorted.
hints: Convert to Vec, sort, and print.

steps.title: HashSet Union and Intersection
steps.description: Create two HashSets: `set_a = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` and `set_b = [4, 5, 6, 7, 8]`. Print their union and intersection.
hints: Both return iterators: collect into Vec for printing.

verification.failureMessage: Print union and intersection of the two sets.
